name: exec-pack
title: Executive S&OP pack
for_each: select id, 'S&OP ' || to_char(month,'Month YYYY') as name from cycles where stage <> 'closed'

sections.title: The cycle
sections.sql: select to_char(month,'YYYY-MM') as cycle, stage, exec_meeting as meeting, consensus_signed_by as consensus_signed_off_by from cycles where id = $1

sections.title: Plan against budget
sections.sql: select to_char(g.month,'YYYY-MM') as month, g.currency, g.plan_revenue, g.budget_revenue, g.gap from v_gap g, cycles c where c.id = $1 order by g.currency, g.month

sections.title: Where demand and supply do not balance
sections.sql: select family, to_char(min(month),'YYYY-MM') as from_month, status, count(*) as months from v_balance b where b.cycle_id = $1 and status <> 'ok' group by family, status order by family

sections.title: Capacity under pressure
sections.sql: select resource, to_char(month,'YYYY-MM') as month, load_hours, available_hours, utilisation_pct as utilisation, note from v_capacity where utilisation_pct >= 90 and $1::uuid is not null order by resource, month

sections.title: Assumptions behind the plan
sections.sql: select text as assumption, owner, review_by, status from assumptions where cycle_id = $1 order by review_by

sections.title: Decisions still open
sections.sql: select text as decision, owner, due from decisions where status = 'open' and $1::uuid is not null order by due

name: family-plan
title: Family plan sheet
for_each: select id, code || ' ' || name as name from families where active

sections.title: Family
sections.sql: select f.code, f.name, f.unit, f.owner, f.currency, f.price, r.name as line, f.target_cover from families f left join resources r on r.id = f.resource_id where f.id = $1

sections.title: Forecast, supply and stock
sections.sql: select to_char(b.month,'YYYY-MM') as month, p.statistical, p.sales, b.consensus, b.supply, b.closing_stock, b.cover_months, b.status from v_balance b join v_plan p on p.family_id = b.family_id and p.month = b.month where b.family_id = $1 order by b.month

sections.title: How the forecast has done
sections.sql: select to_char(month,'YYYY-MM') as month, forecast_lag1 as forecast, actual from v_accuracy_detail where family_id = $1 order by month
